source: General principle, specific implementation. “Shared memory is programmer-managed on-chip storage” is durable. Exact capacity, carveout choices, bank behavior, and cluster-level features depend on ZXNAME0000XZ generation.
zh: 总体原则，具体实施。 “共享内存是程序员管理的片上存储”是持久的。确切的容量、剥离选择、银行行为和集群级功能取决于 ZXNAME0000XZ 一代。
